jobs.title: Senior Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

The Senior Service Delivery Manager works directly with some of the world's largest and most sophisticated AI customers. You will work closely with customer operational teams driving operational excellence and managing our operational relationship. You will prepare for and drive Quarterly Business Reviews, act as a vital bridge between Nscale's global engineering teams and our AMER customer base, and lead regional stakeholder management and service governance. Tactical elements of the role include proactively managing service delivery risks, leading incident response for critical escalations, crafting Root Cause Analysis documents for customers, and ensuring change does not adversely impact the availability of your service.

The successful candidate will own the end-to-end optimization of critical service delivery processes, driving the adoption of modern best practices across our services. By establishing robust Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and timely reporting, you will champion a culture of transparency and continuous improvement, minimizing operational friction and maximizing infrastructure availability for your customer(s).

Ultimately, your leadership will transform data-driven operational insights into tangible service enhancements. By elevating service quality, scalability, and efficiency, the Senior Service Delivery Manager will directly contribute to Nscale's strategic growth, safeguarding our reputation as the premier trusted partner for the next generation of artificial intelligence.

It's an exciting time to be a part of the AI revolution, come join our team and be at the centre of it all. Plus, data centers full of blinky blue lights, what's more exciting than that?

  

**What You'll be Doing (Responsibilities):**

**Be the customer's operational advisor**

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for your assigned account(s), building relationships with stakeholders from engineers and admins to IT directors and CIOs.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's environment, integrations, business objectives and success criteria.
* Advise customers on service delivery management best practices

**Own service health and operational excellence**

* Proactively monitor account health using usage data, support trends, incidents and SLA performance, and act on risks before they escalate.
* Own the escalation path for critical and high-priority issues: coordinate Support and Engineering, keep customers informed, and drive issues to resolution.
* Lead post-incident reviews and root cause analysis communications, and follow through on preventive actions.
* Track SLA and service-level commitments and report on them transparently.

**Drive adoption and value**

* Run regular operational reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) covering service performance, adoption, open issues, and upcoming changes.
* Identify expansion opportunities and technical needs, and partner with Sales on renewals and growth.

**Be the voice of the customer**

* Represent customer needs internally
* Contribute to internal playbooks, knowledge base articles and process improvements for the Service Delivery team.

**Team**

* Provide mentorship to the team, fostering a high-performing culture of continuous improvement and professional growth, constantly raising the bar
* Participate in on call rotation
* Distilling operational learnings and scaling insights to other customers globally

**About You (Skills / Qualifications):**

**Qualifications & Core Expertise**

* 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Account Manager, Service Delivery Manager, Solutions Engineer, Support Engineer or Technical Consultant.
* Strong technical foundation in modern cloud infrastructure, including working knowledge of APIs, integrations, networking, identity and authentication, and system troubleshooting.
* Proven ability to manage complex Large Scale Event (LSE) escalations calmly, coordinating multiple teams under pressure.
* Experience owning a portfolio of enterprise customers and running executive-level reviews.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both engineers and business leaders.
* Familiarity with ITIL or similar service management practices (incident, problem and change management).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficient in utilising ITSM tools like Jira, analytics platforms, and operational data to extract actionable insights, build robust reporting frameworks, and champion continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.

**About the Role**

**Location:** New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, London  
**Commitment:** 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for someone who makes customers successful, not just satisfied. Our customers run agents on real work, where the output has to be right the first time.

As a Customer Success Manager at Endex, you'll own deployment, onboarding, adoption and renewal across our accounts. You'll work directly with our founders, AEs and product team to shape how customers succeed and what we build next.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts from signature through renewal. Know their goals, their teams and exactly where Endex fits in their work.
* **Lead Deployments:** Get new customers live fast. Run kickoffs, configure integrations and partner with IT and InfoSec to clear the path to production.
* **Train and Enable Users:** Run onboarding sessions and workshops that show teams what agents can do across email, Teams, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Make every user productive in their first week.
* **Drive Adoption:** Monitor usage, find the teams getting the most value and replicate it across the firm. Turn a single team's pilot into firmwide deployment.
* **Protect and Expand Accounts:** Spot risk early and fix it before it becomes churn. Surface expansion opportunities and partner with AEs on renewals and upsells.
* **Be the Voice of the Customer:** You'll hear every request, edge case and frustration first. Translate that into product feedback, bug reports and roadmap input that keeps us ahead.
* **Build the Function:** Create the onboarding playbooks, health metrics and support processes we'll scale on. You're not just running customer success. You're helping define it.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Proven customer leader:** 2+ years in customer success, account management, implementation or consulting. You've owned enterprise accounts and grown them.
* **Customer-obsessed:** You care whether the people you work with actually succeed. You follow up, follow through and make yourself the person customers call first.
* **Technically fluent:** You learn new software quickly and can explain it to anyone. You're comfortable working through integrations, security questions and edge cases with engineers.
* **Credible with experts:** You can hold your own with analysts, operators and executives. You learn a domain fast and speak its language.
* **Commercially minded:** You see renewals and expansion as part of the job. You know how to turn a happy customer into a bigger one.
* **Relentlessly resourceful:** You move fast, leverage your network and figure things out without a playbook.

**Nice to Have**

* Early-stage startup experience
* Experience deploying AI, developer tools or enterprise software

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Health & Dental Insurance
* Monthly Wellness Stipend
* 401K Matching
* Competitive Salary + Equity

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**Additional Information**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Mintlify?**
=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring an Account Manager to grow Mintlify's relationships with a book of customers, each typically $50K–$250K in annual recurring revenue. You'll own the commercial side of these accounts: renewals, expansion, and pricing conversations. Customer Success owns adoption and the day-to-day relationship, and you'll work as one team with them.

Your job is to find where Mintlify can do more for each customer, such as another product team's docs, a help center, or growing AI usage, and turn it into growth. Our buyers are engineering, developer experience, and documentation leaders, so you'll need to be comfortable talking about how docs are built and shipped, even if you don't write code.

* **Team:** Account Management, working alongside Customer Success and our other Account Managers
* **Reports to:** Ben Terrill, Head of Customer Success
* **Location:** San Francisco, in office when you're not traveling
* **Travel:** About one trip per month for customer visits, business reviews, and events
* **Type:** Full-time, quota-carrying

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Own and grow your book**

* Manage a book of accounts, each typically $50K–$250K ARR.
* In partnership with a CSM, build an account plan for each: stakeholders, contract terms, usage, and where we can grow.
* Support renewals end to end: forecast early, negotiate terms, and propose multi-year agreements where they fit.

### **Find and close expansion with Customer Success**

* Partner with your CSMs to turn customer signals, such as new teams, new products, or rising AI usage, into qualified opportunities.
* Run discovery, build the business case, then negotiate and close: new sites for other products or business units, help centers and knowledge bases, AI credits, and add-ons.
* Right-size offers: sell the capability a customer needs instead of defaulting to the full bundle.

### **Show up in person and go beyond your champion**

* Spend about one week a month with customers: on-site visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.
* Build relationships across engineering, developer experience, docs, and procurement, not just with your champion.

### **Run a clean commercial process**

* Keep Salesforce current: opportunities, stages, next steps, contacts, and renewal dates.
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately 30, 60, and 90 days out.
* Bring customer feedback on pricing, packaging, and product gaps back to Product and leadership.
* Share what works with the Account Management team so the best plays become repeatable.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3+ years in a quota-carrying account management role, or an AE role with expansion ownership, at a B2B SaaS company.
* A track record of growing mid-market or enterprise accounts ($50K+ ARR), with expansion numbers you can name.
* Moderate technical understanding: you can explain how a team writes, reviews, and publishes docs (Git, Markdown, APIs, CI/CD), hold your own with engineering leaders, and know when to bring in a Solutions Engineer.
* Strong discovery and negotiation skills, including renewals, multi-year terms, and working with procurement.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, with clear ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Organized and data-driven: disciplined in Salesforce, accurate in forecasting, and able to read usage data to time an expansion.
* Willing to travel about one week a month.
* Able to work from our San Francisco office when you're not traveling.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've sold developer tools, API platforms, or other products bought by engineering teams.
* Experience with usage-based pricing, such as credits or overages.
* You've used Mintlify or another docs platform.
* Familiarity with AI products (AI search, assistants, MCP) and how teams adopt them.
* Early-stage startup experience, especially helping build an account management or expansion motion.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **30 days:** You know your book (every account's contract, renewal date, usage, and key contacts), you've met your CSM partners and top customers, and you have a plan for each account.
* **90 days:** Every renewal in the next two quarters has a plan and a next step, you've made your first on-site visits, and your qualified expansion pipeline is growing.
* **6 months:** You're closing expansion every month, renewals land on time without surprises, and your forecast is reliable.
* **12 months:** You've hit your expansion number, your book grows net revenue year over year, and at least one play you built is used across the team.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend

This role blends strategy, execution, and relationship depth: you'll act as the captain for your accounts, orchestrating internal and customer teams, solving challenges, and ensuring every customer achieves tangible outcomes with HackerRank.

At Hamilton Families, we believe the San Francisco Bay Area is at its best when people from all backgrounds can start a life here, raise a family here, and thrive here. We envision a Bay Area where housing is accessible and affordable, where homelessness is rare, brief, and nonrecurring, and where all people and families have a safe and stable place to live. jobs.title: Global Account Manager - Consulting & Research Agencies
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re hiring a **Global Account Manager, Consulting & Research Agencies** to own and aggressively grow Outset’s relationships with the world’s leading **management consulting and professional services firms**.

A global consulting firm is not one customer; it’s hundreds. Strategy, customer and CX, digital and product, marketing, private equity and due diligence practices each run research for their clients—across dozens of countries, with partner-level budget owners and engagement-by-engagement buying. Firms also increasingly want to deliver AI-powered research as part of their own client offerings. That makes consulting both one of our biggest direct markets and a powerful route to the world’s largest enterprises.

This is a **senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales**. You’ll carry **full commercial ownership of a small number of global firms**—expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal—and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You’ll go deep in a handful of firms, build relationships from engagement managers to practice leaders to firm leadership, and turn project-by-project usage into firm-wide agreements.

You’ll do it with an account team around you—Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team—and in close partnership with our Partnerships team where firms bring Outset to their clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of a small number of **global consulting and professional services firms**, with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Carry and exceed an **aggressive seven-figure growth target** across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each firm: every practice, industry group, region, and research function; partner-level relationships; whitespace and spend; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Convert **engagement-by-engagement usage into firm-wide and multi-year agreements**, including enterprise licenses, preferred-vendor status, and global MSAs.
* Multi-thread relentlessly—from consultants and engagement managers to partners, practice leaders, and firm leadership—building relationships durable enough to survive partner turnover and reorgs.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors) across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that tie Outset to firm outcomes—faster engagements, higher-margin delivery, and differentiated client offerings—and convert them into committed budget.
* Negotiate and close complex agreements—global MSAs, multi-region commitments, procurement, security, and client-data confidentiality reviews—in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of consulting firms back into Outset—informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion.
* Regularly meet in person with partner leads across practices to create deep relationships with those driving business performance and who are responsible for partner-level results delivery, as well as operational leaders in centralized roles.

**Qualifications**

* **10+ years in enterprise sales**, including **5+ years in a named global or strategic account role** owning a small book of major accounts.
* **Demonstrated experience and expertise selling into and growing accounts at global consulting, market research and professional services firms**—strategy firms, the Big Three, the largest global market research agencies or large digital and technology consultancies.
* Deep understanding of how consulting firms buy: **partner-led decisions, practice and regional budgets, engagement-funded spend**, and central procurement.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts*—expansion, cross-sell, and renewal—not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management, with accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with partners and firm leadership, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority.
* Experience with complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor—a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced startup that is still building the playbook.
* Travel regularly to customer sites will be necessary to achieve your goals, and should be part of your prior playbook. Travel to our San Francisco HQ will also be required periodically.
* Bonus: prior consulting experience, or experience selling research, insights,

jobs.title: Recruiter / People Operations
jobs.description:
**LiveX AI · Recruiter / People Operations**  
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, in-person · Department: People · Reports to: CEO  
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/recruiter-people-operations (posted Oct 6, 2026)

### **About LiveX AI**

LiveX AI builds human-AI interfaces for physical spaces. Its 4K full-body AI agents greet, guide, and sell in retail flagships, hotels, hospitals, airports, convention centers, and stadiums, on-prem or in the cloud, in 140 languages.

### **About the Role**

LiveX is growing across engineering, solutions, go-to-market, and operations, and hiring has outgrown what the founders can handle. This is the company's first dedicated People hire: no HR team, no existing processes. Own full-cycle recruiting for all open roles and the employee experience from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, plus clean exits. Roughly 70% recruiting / 30% onboarding and offboarding. Reports to the CEO, works with every hiring manager; a path to Head of People as the team grows.

### **Responsibilities**

**Recruiting (primary)**

* Run full-cycle recruiting for engineering (AI/ML, full-stack, hardware/edge), solution engineering, sales/GTM, and operations: intake, job posts, sourcing, screening, scheduling, debriefs, offers, closing.
* Proactively build pipeline via sourcing tools, referrals, university/new-grad programs, AI and robotics communities, and events such as NVIDIA GTC; do not wait for inbound.
* Run a fast, candidate-friendly process: structured interviews, scorecards, same-week feedback, weekly pipeline report for the founders.
* Set up and maintain the ATS and key hiring metrics: time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer-accept rate, cost per hire.
* Manage agency and contract recruiters when used: negotiate terms, enforce quality, control spend.
* Work with founders on offers: leveling, base pay, commission and equity framing, closing candidates with competing offers.

**Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Own signed offer through day 90: offer letters, background checks, I-9 and E-Verify, new-hire paperwork, equipment/account setup with engineering, first-week schedules, 30/60/90-day check-ins.
* Keep the onboarding guide current; every new hire correctly set up in payroll, benefits, and the cap table on day one.
* Coordinate visa-related onboarding (H-1B, OPT/STEM OPT, TN) with outside immigration counsel: document collection, timelines, employee communication.
* Run offboarding: exit checklists, equipment/access recovery, final pay timing under California rules, exit interviews, documentation.
* Maintain accurate, compliant personnel files; point of contact for paperwork, benefits enrollment, and policy questions.

### **Requirements**

* 3–6 years of full-cycle recruiting, including in-house at an early-stage startup (seed to Series B, under ~50 employees).
* Experience hiring both software engineers and salespeople.
* Hands-on onboarding and offboarding end to end, including I-9 and new-hire compliance for California employees.
* Strong sourcing skills; comfortable cold-reaching senior ML engineers or enterprise AEs.
* Organized and systems-minded: builds processes, keeps ATS and personnel records clean without prompting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; often the first impression of LiveX for candidates.
* Discretion with compensation, equity, immigration, and personnel matters.
* Early-stage operator mindset; comfortable with no existing HR function.
* Able to work on-site in Palo Alto.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Recruiting for AI/ML, robotics, computer vision, or hardware roles.
* Hands-on with a modern ATS, HRIS/payroll platform, and cap-table software.
* Experience working with immigration counsel on employment visa cases.

### **Compensation**

Base salary $110,000 – $150,000 per year, plus equity and benefits; placement depends on experience and skills.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Send a resume and a short note describing the hardest role you have closed to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Recruiter / People Operations".

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

We are a small team working on non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, starting with a headset that helps turn thought into text. It's early, hard research, and we're working on it together in San Francisco.

That work happens in our San Francisco office: research, engineering, and the data collection sessions that train our models. We're hiring our first Office Manager to run it, full-time and in person.

**Why this role matters to us**
-------------------------------

We're a team that takes pride in operational excellence. When the office runs well, researchers stay focused, participants have a great experience, and new teammates are productive on day one. When it doesn't, everything slows down.

This role is what keeps it running well. We treat it as core to the company, and you'll work directly with the founding team.

At its heart, this role is about care. You'll get to know the people here, notice what they need, and look after the space as if it were your own. If making a place feel welcoming and well run is something you take pride in, we'd love to meet you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Run the office**

* Keep food, snacks, and supplies stocked, and set up a simple way for people to request things.
* Manage cleaning, vendors, inventory, and device tracking.
* Own upkeep of the space: furniture, internet, utilities, keys and building access, air and temperature.
* Greet guests, candidates, and research participants, and set up a guest-access system for the office.

### **Take care of the team**

* Make each teammate's day-to-day setup smooth, from a new hire's first morning to small preferences.
* Notice what's broken or unsystematized and fix it.

### **Run company operations**

* Run payroll and similar important administrative work.
* Coordinate the hiring process: schedule interviews, host candidates on site, and keep them updated.
* Plan team events and offsites.
* Help make our data collection sessions a delightful experience for the participants who come in.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Proactive. You notice things before they become problems, and you'd rather fix something than report it.
* Warm and caring. People are glad when you walk in, and you treat everyone the same, from visitors to the CEO.
* Proud of your work. You care about the details, including the parts of the job that feel small.
* Organized. You keep many small threads moving without dropping any of them.

**Compensation and logistics**
------------------------------

* Location: San Francisco, fully in office, Monday to Friday
* Schedule: Full-time; we're open to part-time for an exceptional candidate
* Base salary: $110,000–$150,000, depending on experience
* Equity: Yes
* Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance

**Application process**
-----------------------

Our process:

* A 20-minute call to get to know each other.
* A conversation with the team in our office.
* A paid one- or two-day work trial, where you'll do real tasks alongside us.
* Reference checks
* Offer

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Growth Strategy & Operations (Experiments/Campaigns)
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

### **How you'll make impact**

You’ll build and run the experimentation engine behind Airwallex’s global growth: what we test, how we test it, and how we know when we’re right.

* Own the end-to-end execution of growth experiments and campaigns, translating strategic hypotheses into operational workflows, coordinating launches and rollouts, and synthesising learnings to inform the next iteration.
* Manage the experimentation backlog, campaign calendar, measurement approach, tracking taxonomy, dashboards, QA processes, and reporting across Commercial, Growth, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Data and Legal.
* Identify gaps in tooling and process, then codify repeatable work into scalable systems, including checklists, QA scripts, readout templates and registry libraries. Use AI with clear guardrails and human review before anything customer-facing goes live.
* Partner with FP&A on forecasting and budget tracking, balancing speed with experimental rigour, data quality and effective cross-functional execution.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

### **What we're looking for**

**Essentials**

* 2+ years of experience in growth, operations, product management, or strategy roles
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort working with data and metrics
* Experience designing or coordinating experiments, with familiarity with A/B testing methodology
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesise and present insights clearly
* Ability to execute in ambiguity and adapt quickly to changing priorities

**Preferred**

* You understand holdouts, statistical power and significance, and you’re fluent in SQL and/or analytics tools such as Hex or Looker
* You can build and QA campaigns across lifecycle, martech and CDP tooling, and you use automation and AI to make repeatable work scale with appropriate guardrails
* You’ve partnered with Engineering and Data teams to deploy experiments at scale
* You can prioritise high-impact opportunities, say no to good ideas when needed, and defend decisions with evidence
* You move easily between Commercial, Product, Marketing, Data and Legal
* You’ve worked in SaaS, fintech or another high-growth technology company and are comfortable with agile and product development methodologies
* Experience with growth operations, A/B testing, project management, campaign management, roadmap planning, SQL or Python, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination

### **You'll thrive here if**

* You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.
* You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.
* You’re not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.
* You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.
* You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

### **Learn more about your team**

Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers.

You’ll build high-traffic platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next-best actions, and measurable incremental value.

The work spans both human + AI and autonomous operating models: AI-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails.

The challenge is to combine consumer-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI-native global financial platform grows.

All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

jobs.description:
Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
The Operations Manager is primarily responsible for management of the day to day operation of components of the program portfolio/department under the direction of the program/department Manager. These tasks may include management and reporting of staff and program/department performance, forecasting, reporting tracking and reporting of program/department metrics. The position is also responsible for establishing, execution, and reporting of all proactive quality assurance processes.
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.
  

* Manage and lead Operations team including Operations Analysts, Field Operations Auditors, Project Specialists, and Project Coordinators.
* Support delivery of operations team goals towards program and portfolio Key Performance Indicators
* Support and deliver payment reviews, application intake, customer service calls, and operations team scheduling
* Program/Project forecasting, tracking, invoicing, and reporting
* Oversight for weekly and monthly departmental/program reporting
* Work with the program teams to identify opportunities for process improvement that would improve customer/client satisfaction
* Work directly with internal functional teams and/or program teams on process and QA projects
* Ensure all documentation on contracts, SOWs, Cost Allocation Agreements, KPIs, etc. are up to date and readily available on SharePoint
* Support the organization of financial, legal, and budget tracking responsibilities in relation to portfolio programs compliance
* Manage and track the compliance requirements for contracts, addendums, proposals, and subcontracts for the portfolio
* Complete special ad-hoc projects and reporting for program, program manager, operations manager, and regional director
* Act as a technical resource/consultant to develop systems, processes, and process improvements for the portfolio
* Manage operations team staffing, budgets, goals, productivity, and provide analysis, solutions and recommendations on the operations team to Operations Manager and Regional Director
* Coordinate the internal support team efforts across the portfolio including reporting, meetings, leadership team coordination, and portfolio wide training and events
* Coordinate portfolio resource sharing inside and outside of the portfolio
* Work with internal customers to support the reporting needs of the portfolio, program, and business

POSITION REQUIREMENTS
  
Education and Experience
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or related field from an accredited college or university.
* Previous operations experience including thorough understanding of energy efficiency or demand response program operations and processes
* 1 – 3 years of progressive team management experience including managing and directing the work of direct reports and teams (preferred)

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
  
  

* Ability to maintain confidentiality
* Ability to analyze financial data and prepare financial reports and statements
* Ability to analyze program performance data and reports
* Proficient in data analysis and programmatic database management, ticketing, reporting, and dashboards
* Data entry skills in entering, tracking, maintaining, and querying databases
* Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to communicate to customers, clients, employees, and supervisor effectively
* Ability to analyze and interpret data and solve practical program problems
* Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide. Knowledge of mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages, and ratios
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Visio
* Ability to identify and resolve project, program, or application issues with customers, clients, trade allies, and internal stakeholders
* Exhibits concern for personal goal attainment, team goal attainment, and programmatic goal attainment
* Committed to diversity and inclusion
* Reliable transportation

Licenses & Certifications
  

* Valid driver’s license

**Compensation & Benefits:**  
Franklin Energy reasonably expects the starting salary for this position to fall between $73,000.00 and $83,000.00 annually. The final offer will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs. Franklin Energy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits; paid time off; paid holidays; and other company-sponsored benefits and programs.
  
  
Travel Requirements
  

* Willingness to travel more than 60%

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Aegis Ventures**

**Aegis Ventures** is a next-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.

### **About the Company**

**Optain** is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.

Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.

In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide. Optain also acquired EyePACS, a teleophthalmology platform with a 15-year history and an established network of licensed optometrists and ophthalmologists who read retinal images for diabetic retinopathy screening.

### **About the Job**

As the **Clinical Operations Manager**, you will own the operations of Optain's provider network - the optometrists and ophthalmologists who read retinal images for health systems, clinics, and community health centers across the United States. The network has run for 15 years on the judgment and relationships of a small number of people. Your job is to turn that into documented policy, a measurable quality program, a capacity model that runs ahead of demand, and a governance rhythm in alignment with Optain’s Medical Director. You will report to the VP of Operations and work day to day with Optain's Medical Director. This is a non-clinical role for someone who has managed a network of contracted clinicians before, writes policy that physicians sign, and knows the difference between running a process and building one that doesn't need you.

Optain is at an inflection point. We have FDA clearance, a growing camera footprint, and a commercial pipeline that is moving fast. Behind every screening exam is a licensed grader reading the images through our EyePACS platform, and the operational infrastructure around that network is being built in real time. This role sits at the center of that work.

This is a remote, US-based position.

### **What You'll Do**

Own the grading playbook, SOPs, onboarding materials, and the provider network policy library

jobs.title: Network Operations Manager

As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

**About the Role:**

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

jobs.title: Intake Operations Supervisor

Koya values integrity, humility, hard-work, camaraderie, and fun. We offer a base + bonus compensation package, and a competitive benefits program.

**Position Summary**

The Supervisor, Sales Support & Patient Intake leads and unites the teams responsible for guiding patients and providers through every step of the Dayspring order journey — from first referral through document collection and order fulfillment. This role brings together the Sales Support and Intake Operations functions under one team-first leader who builds a culture of collaboration, accountability, and shared ownership of the patient and sales experience.

This role is focused primarily on people leadership between the two departments. The Supervisor coaches, develops, and motivates team members across both functions, removes obstacles that stand between the team and its goals, and ensures the two groups operate as a single, well-coordinated unit rather than two disconnected teams handing work back and forth. The ideal candidate is an engaged, hands-on leader who genuinely enjoys developing people, building trust, and creating an environment where the team feels supported, recognized, and set up to succeed — while also ensuring orders are processed accurately, compliantly, and on time.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Team Leadership & Development

* Lead, coach, and support a combined team of Sales Support and Intake Operations Representatives, fostering one connected team culture across both functions.
* Hold regular one-on-ones, team huddles, and performance check-ins to keep team members engaged, supported, and growing in their roles.
* Recruit, onboard, and train new team members; build structured ramp plans so new hires reach full productivity quickly and confidently.
* Identify skill and development opportunities for each team member, and create pathways for cross-training between the Sales Support and Intake Operations functions to build a more versatile, resilient team.
* Recognize and celebrate individual and team wins; actively contribute to a positive, high-trust team environment where people want to do their best work.
* Conduct performance evaluations, set goals collaboratively with team members, and address performance concerns with fairness and consistency.
* Manage team scheduling, workload balancing, and PTO coverage to ensure consistent service levels for sales, referral sources, and patients.

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Manager – Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
For over 25 years, dicentra has been a trusted global leader in regulatory consulting and clinical research for the life sciences and dietary supplement industries. We partner with innovators worldwide to navigate complex regulatory landscapes, turn scientific rigor into commercial success, and bring safe, compliant products to market.

We have an immediate opening for an experienced Clinical Trial Manager to oversee active clinical trial programs, trial site operations, and monitoring activities. We are open to full-time or part-time fixed-term employment, as well as independent consulting arrangements, depending on the candidate’s experience and availability.

**The Opportunity**

In this role, you will take operational ownership of Phase I–IV clinical studies. You will oversee clinical site management, coordinate site monitoring, troubleshoot clinic-level challenges, ensure ICH-GCP compliance, and work cross-functionally with data management and trial vendors to hit study milestones on schedule.

You will also serve as a key point of contact for sponsors, investigators, and external partners, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution of study-related challenges.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Trial Planning & Execution: Plan, initiate, and manage clinical studies in compliance with ICH-GCP, study protocols, and company SOPs, ensuring study timelines, budgets, and deliverables are met.
* Monitoring & Site Management: Coordinate clinical site monitoring activities, verify data integrity, and support clinical trial sites directly.
* Clinic Problem Resolution: Act as primary escalation contact for trial sites and clinical staff, proactively troubleshooting deviations, patient recruitment hurdles, and operational bottlenecks.
* Vendor & Data Coordination: Collaborate with Data Management and trial vendors on CRF review, EDC user acceptance testing (UAT), query resolution, and database lock.
* Ethics & Regulatory Submissions Support: Support site-level IRB/REB submissions, essential document collection, and inspection-readiness maintenance.
* Clinical Documentation Oversight: Review and provide operational input on study protocols, informed consent forms, and other essential clinical trial documentation.

**Qualifications & Background**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Nursing, or related field.
* Experience: 5+ years of clinical research experience, with at least 3+ years in clinical trial management or senior CRA/site monitoring roles within a CRO or sponsor environment.
* Regulatory Acumen: Deep working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and Health Canada / FDA clinical trial operational requirements.
* Execution Focus: Strong project management abilities, organizational skills, and a track record of driving trials to database lock.
* Sponsor & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to independently manage sponsor relationships, coordinate cross-functional teams, and resolve complex clinical trial challenges.

**Why join us**

**Best Workplace**
  
*We nourish an environment devoted to honesty and fairness, trust and respect. We care deeply for our team members and take work-life balance seriously, allowing our people to decide on a schedule that best fits their life and working preferences.*

**Best People**
  
*We unite cross-industry professionals with a shared passion for improving people’s health and wellness. Our inspiring leaders are accessible and work eagerly side-by-side with individual employees to help them understand and achieve their objectives.*

**Best Opportunities**
  
*We encourage our team members to continuously develop and enhance their skills and expertise. We recognize and reward courageous choices and innovative ideas that result in the growth of our people and company, and the success of our clients.*

**Become a part of a purpose-driven and future-oriented business that impacts and improves millions of lives worldwide!**

**Job Type:** Full-Time Employment, Part-Time Employment, or Independent Consulting Contract (Project-Based / Ad-Hoc)

**Location:** Ontario (Fully Remote)

This position is available to fill immediately.

We welcome applications from qualified professionals interested in full-time or part-time fixed-term employment, as well as independent consulting arrangements. Please indicate your preferred engagement arrangement and availability when applying.

Applying:

As part of the hiring process, in addition to interviewing, successful candidates may be required to complete a skills assessment and a reference/background check. If you are sent a skills assessment, please complete it for consideration for the advertised position.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Position Overview**  
  
The **Program Manager** leads day-to-day delivery for a program, major initiative, or coordinated set of related projects and workstreams involving Adobe Experience Cloud solutions. The role establishes integrated governance and planning, coordinates project managers and cross-functional contributors, and ensures scope, schedules, budgets, dependencies, quality, risks, and outcomes are managed as a connected whole.  
  
Serving as the primary delivery escalation point within the assigned scope, the Program Manager aligns client and internal stakeholders on priorities and tradeoffs, resolves cross-workstream constraints, and maintains program-level transparency. The role guides project managers through delegation, review, and coaching while escalating account, portfolio, or organizational decisions to the appropriate owners and improving delivery practices across the program.  
  
**Location:** Remote – United States

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Planning & Governance**

* Lead day-to-day delivery for a program, major initiative, or coordinated set of related projects and workstreams.
* Establish integrated program governance, plans, milestones, financial views, dependencies, risks, reporting, and decision routes.

**Program & Project Delivery**

* Clear communication skills and the ability to align stakeholders, surface tradeoffs, and maintain program-level transparency.

**Role Expectations**

jobs.description:
Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid — bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.  
  
We are seeking an experienced Customer Program Manager to lead customer-facing programs for the Karman platform, from initial evaluation through pilot deployment, design win, and long-term adoption. This role combines program management discipline with strong customer engagement skills, acting as the single point of accountability across customers, Engineering, Product, Sales, and executive teams. You'll join a diverse team of experts who are mission-driven, collaborative and adaptive, working at the intersection of AI infrastructure and power systems.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and single point of accountability for Karman customer programs, ensuring deliverables, timelines, and milestones are met from initial engagement through pilot deployment, design win, and scale-out.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans across Engineering, Product, and Operations; track program status, risks, and dependencies, and proactively drive resolution.
* Establish trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders at technical, business, and executive levels, driving clarity in customer requirements and translating them into actionable internal deliverables.
* Coordinate joint planning sessions and program update meetings with customers throughout the Karman pilot lifecycle.
* Partner with Solutions Architects and Application Engineers to align resources for customer success, and interface with Product Management to relay customer feedback and influence roadmap priorities.
* Collaborate with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure a smooth transition from pilot deployment to operational excellence.
* Ensure Karman proof-of-concept, pilot, and deployment activities are executed successfully; track KPIs (adoption, performance, ROI) and communicate progress internally and externally.
* Manage change control across customer programs, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule integrity.
* Identify program risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate critical issues with context and recommended solutions.
* Maintain transparency with customers on program status and next steps across all phases of the Karman pilot engagement.

  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in program or project management, including timeline management, risk tracking, and reporting, ideally within a technology or hardware-adjacent environment.
* Strong customer communication and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to align technical execution with business outcomes.
* Proven ability to navigate cross-functional teams and drive accountability across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Engineering, and Product.
* Working knowledge of data center operations, AI/ML systems, or edge computing environments.
* Understanding of solution integration lifecycles, including evaluation, proof-of-concept, deployment, and scale.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing status reports, program plans, and executive-level updates.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience in program management, technical account management, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site customer engagements, pilot deployments, and program reviews.

  
**Enhanced Qualifications (Nice to Have)**

* Hands-on experience with project management software such as Jira, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
* Experience with collaboration tools such as Slack, Teams, and Confluence.
* Experience with CRM, KPI, and reporting/telemetry dashboards such as HubSpot or Grafana.
* Prior experience supporting pilot or early-access programs for hardware/software co-designed products.

  
**Salary Range:** $140,000 to $190,000 base compensation depending on experience, plus stock options. Salary will be commensurate with an individual's skills, training, years of experience, and in line with internal compensation bands.  
  
**Location:** This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States.  
  
**Our Commitments:**  
Karman values the diversity of our team. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or childbirth, sexual orientation, genetics, genetic information, marital status, or status as a covered veteran or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws.

* Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that is welcoming, supportive, affirming and respectful
* Empowering employees to solve problems and work together to make a difference
* Providing mentorship and growth opportunities as part of a collaborative team
* A flexible work environment with flexible paid time off
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including health, dental, vision, and employer-match 401k

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.description:
The QA Lead is accountable for the quality assurance practice across product delivery, ensuring that software is testable, test execution is timely and transparent, critical defects are surfaced early, and releases meet agreed quality standards. This role leads day-to-day QA planning and execution, strengthens automation and regression coverage, coaches QA team members, and works closely with Product Owners and Engineering to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final-stage activity.  
  
The QA Lead is expected to create clear visibility into test readiness, progress, risk, and blockers. The role owns the operating discipline of QA: defining test approaches, ensuring execution begins when planned, maintaining useful quality metrics, driving defect triage, and escalating issues early when delivery or release quality is at risk.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
Quality Leadership & Accountability

* Own the day-to-day QA practice and establish consistent expectations for test planning, execution, documentation, and release readiness.
* Ensure QA work begins when planned and that delays, blockers, environment issues, data needs, or scope gaps are identified and communicated immediately.
* Create transparency into what has been tested, what remains untested, current defects, quality risks, and confidence in release readiness.
* Hold QA team members accountable for execution commitments, timely updates, accurate status reporting, and follow-through.
* Coach QA team members on testing discipline, risk-based thinking, root-cause analysis, and stronger ownership of outcomes.

Test Strategy, Planning & Execution

* Develop and maintain test strategies for new features, enhancements, integrations, defects, and platform changes.
* Partner with Product Owners early in discovery and refinement to identify test scenarios, edge cases, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria before development is complete.
* Ensure test cases provide adequate functional, integration, regression, negative, end-to-end, and workflow coverage based on business and technical risk.
* Coordinate test data, environments, integrations, and dependencies required for successful QA execution.
* Confirm that critical workflows can be tested end-to-end before work is considered ready for business UAT.
* Use risk-based testing to prioritize the highest-value scenarios when time or environment constraints require tradeoffs.

Defect Management & Release Readiness

* Lead defect triage in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring severity, priority, business impact, and ownership are clear.
* Track critical defects through resolution and retest and ensure unresolved quality risks are explicitly documented before release decisions.
* Define and enforce practical QA exit criteria, including expectations for critical defect closure, regression completion, and stability.
* Provide an objective quality recommendation for releases based on test evidence and known risk.
* Identify recurring defect patterns and partner with Engineering and Product on preventive actions rather than relying only on downstream testing.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

* Develop and maintain a pragmatic test automation strategy focused on high-value regression, repeatable workflows, integrations, and business-critical scenarios.
* Partner with QA Automation Engineers and Engineering to increase reliable automated coverage without creating brittle or low-value automation.
* Use modern AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to accelerate test-case creation, test-data design, automation development, and quality analysis while preserving human review and accountability.
* Evaluate test tooling, frameworks, and processes and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, coverage, and maintainability.
* Reduce manual regression effort over time by identifying the strongest candidates for automation and incorporating automated tests into delivery pipelines where feasible.

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Work closely with Product Owners to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and aligned to expected business outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering on defect prevention, unit/integration test expectations, environment stability, observability, and root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with Architecture and platform teams when quality issues involve integration, infrastructure, data movement, or systemic technical risk.
* Support business UAT by ensuring the product is genuinely ready for validation and by helping distinguish blocking defects from non-blocking follow-up work.
* Communicate quality risk in clear business terms so leadership can make informed release and prioritization decisions.

Metrics & Reporting

* Maintain a small, actionable set of QA metrics that reflect product quality and execution health rather than activity alone.
* Track measures such as test execution progress, escaped defects, defect severity, defect reopen rate, regression coverage, automation coverage, UAT rework, and recurring defect trends.
* Use metrics to identify systemic improvement opportunities and to show whether changes to process, automation, or requirements quality are producing measurable results.
* Provide concise status reporting that clearly states current quality, material risks, blockers, required decisions, and next actions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant hands-on experience in software quality assurance, including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience leading QA execution, mentoring testers, or functioning as a senior/lead resource responsible for quality outcomes.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery and the role of QA throughout discovery, development, testing, UAT, and release.
* Demonstrated ability to create test strategies and translate complex business workflows into thorough, risk-based test coverage.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Serving the largest customer ecosystem in regulated energy, HData helps utilities, regulators, advocates, advisory firms, and energy technology companies turn regulatory complexity into strategic advantage. By reducing the time and cost burdens of manual research and analysis, the HData platform enables teams to efficiently monitor regulatory developments, prepare for proceedings, mitigate potential risks, and confidently make decisions that consider comprehensive data.

We are a venture-backed Techstars company with investment from firms including Buoyant Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, Firebrand Ventures, and MassMutual Ventures. We work closely with our customers to understand their pains, and we collaborate across all teams to build and deliver exceptional products.

### **THE OPPORTUNITY**

HData is building the first extension of an Enterprise Customer Success team dedicated to Data Request Management (DRM), an AI-native platform solution that helps utilities manage and respond to the hundreds of regulatory data requests they receive during rate cases and other proceedings. As a Senior Enterprise CSM, you’ll own large, multi-team DRM deployments at some of the country’s largest utilities, guiding them from rollout to measurable value, and you’ll help define how HData delivers DRM success at scale.

We are hiring up to two team members for this role, with level (Enterprise CSM or Senior Enterprise CSM) based on experience.

This is a remote role open to candidates in any U.S. time zone, with up to 20% travel for onsite deployments, executive reviews and industry events.

### **WHO YOU ARE**

You’ll thrive here if:

* You’re energized by building something new: playbooks, processes, and the first version of how things are done.
* You’re at ease in a room with a VP of Regulatory Affairs and equally comfortable configuring a workflow with their analysts.
* You lead with curiosity and learn complex domains quickly.
* You measure success by customer outcomes, and revenue follows from that value.

### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Lead Enterprise Deployments**

* Own onboarding and rollout of DRM across large utility customers, leading discovery, mapping use cases to workflows, and partnering with Solutions Architecture on configuration.
* Guide customers through change management across legal, regulatory and operations teams, from executive sponsor to end user, with a focus on early, measurable value.
* Deliver training and workshops that establish HData as a core part of each customer’s regulatory process.

**Build Strategic Relationships**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for your book of customers.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business objectives and build a mutually agreed success plan that defines, tracks and measures HData’s impact.
* Lead executive business reviews and steering committees with your most strategic customers.

**Drive Adoption and Customer Health**

* Monitor usage, adoption and health data to identify risk early, close training gaps and surface new opportunities.
* Escalate critical issues to the right internal teams, keep customers informed through resolution, and advocate for their needs with Product.
* Develop reference customers, power users and advocates.
* Report weekly on success KPIs to internal stakeholders.

**Own Renewals and Expansion**

* Lead renewals and grow accounts by identifying new use cases, teams and departments where HData can deliver value.
* Partner with Account Executives on account strategy, proofs of concept and expansion opportunities.

**Bring Industry Insight**

* Stay current on utility regulatory trends and use that knowledge to share best practices and benchmarks with customers.
* Connect customers with peers to build a collaborative DRM community.

### **WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree or MS degree.
* 3+ Years of Experience in enterprise CS or account management (6+ years for Sr. ECSM), with a track record of managing a multimillion-dollar book.
* Enterprise SaaS experience, ideally with workflow, response management, compliance, legal technology, or security platforms.
* Proven ability to build strong relationships with both technical stakeholders and executives, with ability to identify, forecast, and negotiate complex contract expansions and renewals with C-level and procurement stakeholders.
* Deep experience managing the full customer lifecycle and growing a portfolio of complex Enterprise accounts, from onboarding and enablement to renewal, risk and escalations, expansion, and advocacy.
* Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.

### **BONUS POINTS**

* Experience supporting customers in regulated or compliance-heavy environments (energy, financial services, security, legal, or government), and the curiosity to learn utility regulatory processes quickly.

### **WHAT WE VALUE**

* Be kind
* Think and act with humility
* Be resourceful
* Listen to others
* Show empathy
* Have fun and enjoy others

### **WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Compensation:** $135-155k OTE (base + variable); commensurate with experience
* **Equity:** We offer equity to every employee at HData.
* **Location:** We’re a remote-based company. As long as you’re in the US, you can work from anywhere!

jobs.title: Regulatory Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early phase site network, fully dedicated to oncology clinical research. Throughout our history, START has provided hope to cancer patients in global community practices by offering **"Hope Through Access”** to cutting edge trials throughout the United States and Europe.

We are hiring for a **Regulatory Operations Specialist (Remote)** who will prepare and submit documents for new and existing studies to the Institutional Review Board (IRB), US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) for review, maintain the Investigator Site File (ISF) for assigned investigational drug studies and corresponding documents at START USA sites.

This is a remote role. The hourly pay for this remote role is $25 - $28/hour. However, base pay may vary depending on multiple individualized factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Prepare and submit new studies, including drafting the informed consent (IC), to the IRB as assigned under supervision. Serve as primary point of contact with the Sponsor/CRO in negotiating the IC for IRB submission. Serve as the main point of contact with the IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up on pending items.
* Prepare and submit study documents to the IRB for assigned studies under supervision. This includes, but is not limited to, revised protocols, revised investigator’s brochures, protocol clarification letters/memos, revised ICs, new ICs, continuing review reports, closure reports, serious adverse events, IND safety reports, unanticipated problems, protocol deviations, waivers, etc. Serve as the main point of contact with the IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up on pending items.
* Prepare and submit study documents to the Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) as assigned under supervision. Serve as the main point of contact with the IBC for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s), note pending information and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up, as required, on pending items.
* Prepare and submit Expanded Access Studies to the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as assigned under supervision. Serve as the main point of contact with the FDA and IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up, as required, on pending items.
* Maintain ISF (paper and/or electronic) for assigned studies. This includes, but not limited to, IRB submissions, IRB approvals, and correspondence.

  

**Required Education and Experience:**

* High School Diploma/GED.
* 5 years of experience in a regulatory research setting.
* Proficient working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook 365.
* Prior experience with regulatory document management system (i.e. Veeva, Advarra E-Reg).
* Strong organizational skills and a sense of timeliness in completing projects.
* Strong knowledge of medical and clinical research terminology.

  

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree.

  

**Best-in-Class Benefits and Perks**

We value our employees’ time and efforts. Our commitment to your success is enhanced by a competitive compensation, depending on experience, and an extensive benefits package including:

* Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance provided
* Robust retirement planning: 401(k) plan available with employer matching
* Financial security: Life and disability insurance for added protection
* Flexible financial options: Health savings and flexible spending accounts offered
* Well-being and work-life balance: Paid time off, flexible schedule, and remote work choices provided
* Plus, we work to maintain the best environment for our employees, where people can learn and grow with the company. We strive to provide a collaborative, creative environment where everyone feels encouraged to contribute to our processes, decisions, planning, and culture.

  

**More About START**

  

START clinical trial sites have conducted more than 1,000 early-phase clinical trials, including dozens of therapies that were approved by the FDA or EMA. START represents the world’s largest roster of early-phase principal investigators across its Network of clinical trial sites. Committed to accelerating passage from trials to treatments, START delivers hope to patients, families, and physicians around the world via our mission of “Hope Through Access”.

Learn more at STARTresearch.com.

**Ready to be part of a team changing the future of cancer treatment?**  
Join us in our mission to conquer cancer, one clinical trial at a time. Your expertise and dedication can help us bring hope and healing to patients worldwide. Please submit your application online.

Overview:

Marin Community Clinics, founded in 1972, is today, a multi-clinic network with a wide array of integrated primary care, dental, behavioral, specialty and referral services. As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), we provide vital health services to almost 40,000 individuals annually in Marin County. The Clinics regularly receive national awards from the Health Resources and Services Administrations (HRSA). Our Mission is to promote health and wellness through excellent, compassionate care for all.

The APP Residency Program Coordinator manages the daily operational, administrative, and tracking components of Marin Community Clinic’s postgraduate Nurse Practitioner (NP) and Physician Assistant (PA) residency program. This position serves as the primary administrative point of contact for residents, clinical faculty, and leadership. A key focus of this role during the first year will be establishing robust tracking systems and documentation standards to prepare the program for official national accreditation applications.

**Work Schedule:**

Please note that the Coordinator responsibilities represent 0.70 FTE of this position. Internal candidate selected for the role will be expected to continue performing the remaining 0.30 FTE of their current clinical or departmental duties, subject to departmental needs and manager approval.

  
Responsibilities:

**Program Administration & Operations**

* Manage day-to-day administrative tasks for the NP/PA residency program, including onboarding logistics, orientation schedules, and day-to-day schedules.
* Coordinate complex clinical scheduling, including primary care continuity clinics, specialty rotations, and dedicated didactic/educational sessions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for residency applicants, coordinating the recruitment, interview, and selection processes.

**Accreditation Preparation & Data Tracking**

* Build and maintain highly accurate program records, including attendance, clinical hour logs, and faculty/resident evaluation data.

Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Together, we change the world.

We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
