Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Institute of European Studies (IES) at UC Berkeley is the leading research center on Europe in the Western United States, and among the top three such organizations in the nation. Through interdisciplinary scholarship, international collaborations, grant opportunities and community outreach, IES fosters a deeper understanding of Europe's past, present, and future.
  
  
**IES Mission:** Support innovative research and teaching on contemporary and historical Europe, the European Union, and transatlantic relations. Promote academic and cultural ties with European partners. Provide a community for students and faculty who share a European focus to their work. Foster dialogue between scholars, practitioners, policymakers, and the public.

The Program Coordinator supports the organized research activities and programming agendas of the France Berkeley Fund (FBF) and the Institute of European Studies (IES) in consultation with the directors of both organizations. This position supports outreach, communications, program development, and fundraising. To further the mission of both programs, the Program Coordinator promotes and supports research by UCB faculty and visiting researchers via the France Berkeley Fund and the IES Global Exchange programs.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Plans and develops new programs and adjusts existing programs in a research and public education environment.
  
Actively participates with faculty directors (FBF and IES) in long-range strategic planning for research and public educational programs. The FBF, Austrian Studies, Ctr. of French Excellence, Visiting Scholar, and URAP programs.

Under general supervision, assists in implementing specific activities for specific fundraising programs and activities.

Working skills to produce and deliver programs.
  
Good reading, verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, and good presentation skills.
  
Reading knowledge of basic French.
  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
  
Continuing education in related field required.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Working knowledge of departmental and organization policies and procedures and/or the ability to learn; knowledge of educational program content and objectives.
  
Working knowledge of delivering public educational programs.
  
Working knowledge of current public education programs and trends.
  
Working knowledge of conducting needs assessment.
  
Good analytical skills to understand how business needs can be addressed through the design and delivery of training programs.
  
Additional European Languages a plus.
  
  
Salary & Benefits
  
  
For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.
  
  
Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience.
  
  
The budgeted hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $30.17 - $38.31.
  
  
This is a non-exempt, bi-weekly paid position.

new_jobs.description:
**LiveX AI · Project Manager**  
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, on-site · Department: Operations / Deployments · Reports to: founding team  
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/project-manager (posted Jul 24, 2026)

### **About the Role**

LiveX AI builds AI infrastructure for the physical world, deploying interactive AI agents and hardware into high-foot-traffic venues such as hotels, retail flagships, convention centers, and stadiums. Each deployment is custom and requires sales, solution engineering, warehouse readiness, and a third-party delivery partner to stay in sync. This role owns each deployment end to end and works daily with sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics.

### **Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Deployment Ownership**

* Single accountable owner for each deployment, from signed contract to a live, working installation at the customer site.
* Run the deployment schedule: define milestones, sequence dependencies, track status, surface risks and blockers early.
* Internal hub across sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics so nothing falls between teams.

**Scope & Solution Engineering**

* Drive a clear, complete SOW from sales and sales engineering before each deployment starts; push back when scope is ambiguous.
* Track solution engineers through implementation against the SOW, keeping configuration and readiness on schedule.
* Translate customer requirements and site constraints into a concrete deployment plan.

**Logistics & Warehouse Coordination**

* Coordinate with the office/logistics owner and the third-party delivery partner on delivery windows, pickup, and destination readiness.
* Confirm warehouse readiness before each deployment: items staged, configured, health-checked before shipping.
* Manage installation scheduling and any returns or de-installations.

**Customer & Communication**

* Customer-facing point of contact during rollout: set expectations, communicate timelines, manage change requests.
* Run deployment kickoffs and post-deployment reviews; capture lessons; feed improvements into the playbook.
* Report deployment status and the pipeline of upcoming installs to the founding team.

**Process & Systems**

* Build and maintain the deployment playbook, checklists, and tracking so the process is repeatable and scalable.
* Own the tooling that tracks deployment status, asset location, and readiness across the fleet.

### **Requirements**

* Hungry, startup mindset above all: thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, takes extreme ownership, does what it takes to make each install land.
* 3+ years in project management, implementation/deployment management, technical program management, or field-services coordination, ideally at a startup, hardware, or solutions company.
* Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder projects on a schedule and hold others accountable without direct authority.
* Comfortable reading and reasoning about a technical scope of work; talks credibly with solution engineers.
* Strong coordination and communication across internal teams, external partners, and customers.
* Highly organized and self-directed; builds process from scratch.
* Calm under pressure; biased toward closing gaps and driving at-risk deployments to resolution.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience deploying hardware or physical installations into venues or field sites.
* Familiarity with project/deployment tracking tools and a CRM (e.g., HubSpot).
* Background in logistics, shipping, or warehouse operations.
* PMP or similar credential (not required).

### **Compensation**

Not listed.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Email resume and relevant supporting materials to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Project Manager".

The role owns the what, why, and priority of the work, while partnering with Platform Owners and engineering teams on the how, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, governance, and platform standards.

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Work with the Platform Owners, develop and maintain the productivity & automation roadmap aligned with business priorities and technology strategy.
* Identify opportunities where automation, AI, and Microsoft 365 can simplify work, improve employee productivity, or modernize business processes.
* Define expected business outcomes and measures of success.

**Product & Backlog Ownership**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, risk, dependencies, and strategic alignment.
* Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and Platform Owners to evaluate solution options, complexity, dependencies, and technical feasibility.
* Make prioritization and scope trade-offs across competing business demands.

**Business Partnership & Solution Delivery**

* Partner with Product Domain teams to understand workflows, pain points, and automation or AI opportunities.
* Guide initiatives toward reusable enterprise capabilities rather than isolated point solutions where practical.

**Citizen Development & AI Adoption**

* Promote adoption of approved AI tools and identify high-value AI use cases.

SI-BONE is a fast-growing, publicly traded medical device company that is an industry pioneer in minimally invasive sacropelvic solutions. Our mission is to help patients rise up and reach for the stars, and our vision is to work together as the global leader to make sacropelvic conditions universally recognized and effectively treated through innovation, evidence, education, and advocacy.

**Project Manager**

**Location:** San Jose, CA

**Travel:** Occasional - 10-20%

SI-BONE® is focused on helping patients in one of the most under-served, under-diagnosed, and under-treated areas in orthopedics, the sacroiliac (SI) joint. SI-BONE developed an innovative, patented implant to fuse the SI joint. The iFuse Implant System® provides a less invasive alternative to traditional sacroiliac (SI) joint fusion surgery and has been used in over 90,000 procedures to date.

We are a medical device company that is focused on improving the lives of patients with sacroiliac pelvic conditions. We are looking for people who are passionate about our mission and who are willing to work hard to achieve it. We are also looking for people who are:

* Agile: We work in a fast-paced environment and need to be able to learn and adapt to change quickly.

* Creative: We embrace creativity, and we need people who are not afraid to challenge the status quo.

* Team Players: We roll-up our sleeves and work together as one team to achieve our goals.

**General Responsibilities:**

We are seeking a Project Manager that will lead cross-functional projects for products already on the market, and for the business systems and quality programs that support them. The Project Manager will act as the core team leader for your projects. They will align Engineering, R&D, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, IT, Finance, Clinical, Marketing and suppliers around a shared plan and drive it to on-time, high-quality delivery.

The ideal candidate will thrive in a high-growth environment, understand the rigor of medical device design and change controls, and move easily between technical detail and business priorities.

**Specific Responsibilities and Skills:**

* Own program timelines, budgets, and deliverables from initiation through release and closure, including design control and change control milestones.
* Serve as core team leader: define program scope, secure cross-functional alignment, and make sure delivery is both rigorous and timely.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, identifying the critical path, dependencies, and resource needs across functions.
* Proactively assess timelines to anticipate risks and obstacles, develop mitigation plans, and identify opportunities to accelerate delivery.

**Cross-Functional Coordination and Communication**

* Lead core team meetings and convene additional cross-functional working sessions as needed beyond standing engineering and design control reviews.
* Lead cross-functional troubleshooting and root-cause efforts for on-market products, partnering closely with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering to drive resolution.
* Develop and implement program metrics, dashboards, and status reporting so that team commitments (scope, schedule, resources) are tracked and communicated clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Escalate issues and tradeoff decisions to leadership with clear options and recommendations.
* Manage suppliers, contract manufacturers, and implementation partners against agreed scope, cost, and dates.

**Portfolio and Business Impact**

* Manage several projects at once, making and meeting commitments tied to specific business goals.
* Ensure product changes, business system releases, and quality programs meet established objectives for performance, quality, cost, and schedule.
* Consider how each program affects the broader organization, including manufacturing capacity, supply chain, business systems, sales training, and surgeon education.
* Support team members directly on project tasks when needed to keep work moving.

**Compliance and Quality**

* Ensure programs follow design control and change control requirements under 21 CFR Part 820 (QMSR), ISO 13485, and ISO 14971 risk management.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs to plan and support regulatory assessments and submissions for product changes (e.g., 510(k)) and with Quality to maintain complete, audit-ready Design History Files.
* Support CAPA, nonconformance, and audit readiness across your projects.

**Knowledge, Education, & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in related discipline.
* 5+ years of experience as an engineer or project manager in the medical device industry.
* A track record of delivering product and system changes under formal change control.
* Working knowledge of design controls, change control, risk management, and the medical device product lifecycle.
* Cross-disciplinary understanding of engineering, manufacturing, operations, R&D, IT, clinical, regulatory, and quality functions.
* Experience running several concurrent projects across functions against firm deadlines.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with coworkers, surgeons, clinicians, distributor representatives, suppliers, and implementation partners.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in orthopedics; spine or sacropelvic experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in a high-growth medical device company whose products serve a specialty physician audience.
* A history of innovative engineering solutions, cost-effective manufacturing, and ongoing product improvement after launch.
* Experience with ERP or other regulated business-system implementations, including computer system validation.
* Experience managing suppliers or contract manufacturers.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification.
* Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet).

**About Diversified:**  
Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  
**What to Expect:**  
At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  
**How You’ll Contribute:**  
A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.
  
The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  

* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.

* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members. Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Coordinates all deliverable documentation between all internal and external stakeholders. Facilitates and directs document reviews to assure proper documentation is delivered to the client. Provides punch-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates transition of projects to later phase project teams.

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
  
  
**Decision Making Authority:**

* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.

**Physical Demands:**

new_jobs.title: Partner Enablement Lead, Beneficial Deployments
new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team brings Claude to organizations doing some of the world's most important work across the nonprofit and education sectors. These organizations share a problem: mission-critical work, thin budgets, and little slack to figure out new technology on their own. Our Customer Success team helps them go from first login to Claude being part of how their teams work, but we cannot do that one organization at a time, nor should we. The sector already has trusted intermediaries these organizations turn to first: networks, capacity builders, funder technical assistance providers, community colleges, and fellowship programs. This role exists to make those intermediaries as effective at activating and training organizations on Claude as our own Customer Success team is.

As the Scaled Enablement Lead, you'll build the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program that qualifies intermediaries to onboard organizations and deliver Anthropic-designed workshops on our behalf. You'll own the kits, credentials, and quality gates that let them run the show without an Anthropic CSM in the room. You'll also own the enablement thinking behind scaling impact through Claude Corps: how what fellows learn and build serves every organization we support, not only the ones that host them.

The people you enable are not selling Claude. They are trainers, implementers, and program staff whose job is to help mission-driven organizations meaningfully adopt AI. Your job is to make sure these intermediaries can do that with Claude, to the same bar we hold ourselves to, and to help them evolve their offerings as we learn what these organizations need. The measure of success for this role is organizations activated and trained well without Anthropic delivering it.

You'll be half program builder, half facilitator. You'll design and deliver the first cohorts yourself, then make the system repeatable: kits, qualification paths, credentials, teach-back gates, and a refresh rhythm that keeps content current as our products change. You'll build on the operating model and certification infrastructure of Anthropic's Education team and own everything specific to this audience, working closely with Beneficial Deployments Customer Success, Partnerships, Claude Corps program leadership, and our Education teams.

This is not a partner account management or alliances role, and it carries no quota. It is not a book-of-business Customer Success role either, though you'll spend time with organizations to stay grounded in what these nonprofits truly need. The role reports to the Customer Success Lead for Beneficial Deployments, has no direct reports today, and may grow into people management as the program scales. Expect periodic travel for in-person cohorts and sessions.

**Key responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Own the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program end to end: its tracks, the qualification path for each, the credential, and recertification
* Build the kits intermediaries teach from: an activation playbook covering kickoff, admin setup, launch, and Day 30/60/90 reviews, and workshop-in-a-box modules starting with AI fluency and use case discovery, each with a deck, facilitator guide, demo scripts, sample data, and workbook
* Recruit and qualify a pilot cohort of anchor intermediaries, then open a repeatable application process that routes each to the right track and the right home, whether the Claude Partner Network or a Beneficial Deployments credential
* Design and deliver enablement for network intermediaries, adapting the program to how each reaches and supports its members, and help them evolve their offerings as we learn what organizations need
* Build the connective tissue among intermediaries so they learn from each other: shared office hours, a facilitator cohort that stays together after qualification, and a clear path for bringing new intermediaries along
* Support the enablement thinking for Claude Corps: how we extend the reach of fellows and the organizations around the program, and how what they learn feeds back into the enablement every customer receives
* Hold the quality bar when Anthropic is not in the room through teach-back gates, graded mock sessions, shadowing, and session satisfaction and activation quality at or above Anthropic-led benchmarks
* Run the program as one system: content intake and refresh calendar, production standards, resource hub organization, learning management system courses and assessments, and the agreement and attribution model for intermediaries acting on Anthropic's behalf
* Own the program's numbers, including approved trainers, collaborator-led activations and workshops, the Anthropic effort required per organization activated, and quality against benchmark, and use them to decide where the effort goes next
* Be the field voice for intermediaries inside Anthropic, bringing what they learn back into our enablement content, product feedback, and engagement model

**Minimum qualifications:**
---------------------------

* **7+ years of experience** in enablement, training, or program management
* **Train-the-trainer at scale.** You have built and run a program that qualified other people to deliver your training consistently without you in the room: a certified facilitator network, a partner or community education program, or an instructor credential.
* **Learning design and delivery.** You have designed adult learning experiences end to end, including curriculum, facilitator guides, and assessments, and delivered them live

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Why Mintlify?**
=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring an Account Manager to grow Mintlify's relationships with a book of customers, each typically $50K–$250K in annual recurring revenue. You'll own the commercial side of these accounts: renewals, expansion, and pricing conversations. Customer Success owns adoption and the day-to-day relationship, and you'll work as one team with them.

Your job is to find where Mintlify can do more for each customer, such as another product team's docs, a help center, or growing AI usage, and turn it into growth. Our buyers are engineering, developer experience, and documentation leaders, so you'll need to be comfortable talking about how docs are built and shipped, even if you don't write code.

* **Team:** Account Management, working alongside Customer Success and our other Account Managers
* **Reports to:** Ben Terrill, Head of Customer Success
* **Location:** San Francisco, in office when you're not traveling
* **Travel:** About one trip per month for customer visits, business reviews, and events
* **Type:** Full-time, quota-carrying

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Own and grow your book**

* Manage a book of accounts, each typically $50K–$250K ARR.
* In partnership with a CSM, build an account plan for each: stakeholders, contract terms, usage, and where we can grow.
* Support renewals end to end: forecast early, negotiate terms, and propose multi-year agreements where they fit.

### **Find and close expansion with Customer Success**

* Partner with your CSMs to turn customer signals, such as new teams, new products, or rising AI usage, into qualified opportunities.
* Run discovery, build the business case, then negotiate and close: new sites for other products or business units, help centers and knowledge bases, AI credits, and add-ons.
* Right-size offers: sell the capability a customer needs instead of defaulting to the full bundle.

### **Show up in person and go beyond your champion**

* Spend about one week a month with customers: on-site visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.
* Build relationships across engineering, developer experience, docs, and procurement, not just with your champion.

### **Run a clean commercial process**

* Keep Salesforce current: opportunities, stages, next steps, contacts, and renewal dates.
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately 30, 60, and 90 days out.
* Bring customer feedback on pricing, packaging, and product gaps back to Product and leadership.
* Share what works with the Account Management team so the best plays become repeatable.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3+ years in a quota-carrying account management role, or an AE role with expansion ownership, at a B2B SaaS company.
* A track record of growing mid-market or enterprise accounts ($50K+ ARR), with expansion numbers you can name.
* Moderate technical understanding: you can explain how a team writes, reviews, and publishes docs (Git, Markdown, APIs, CI/CD), hold your own with engineering leaders, and know when to bring in a Solutions Engineer.
* Strong discovery and negotiation skills, including renewals, multi-year terms, and working with procurement.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, with clear ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Organized and data-driven: disciplined in Salesforce, accurate in forecasting, and able to read usage data to time an expansion.
* Willing to travel about one week a month.
* Able to work from our San Francisco office when you're not traveling.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've sold developer tools, API platforms, or other products bought by engineering teams.
* Experience with usage-based pricing, such as credits or overages.
* You've used Mintlify or another docs platform.
* Familiarity with AI products (AI search, assistants, MCP) and how teams adopt them.
* Early-stage startup experience, especially helping build an account management or expansion motion.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **30 days:** You know your book (every account's contract, renewal date, usage, and key contacts), you've met your CSM partners and top customers, and you have a plan for each account.
* **90 days:** Every renewal in the next two quarters has a plan and a next step, you've made your first on-site visits, and your qualified expansion pipeline is growing.
* **6 months:** You're closing expansion every month, renewals land on time without surprises, and your forecast is reliable.
* **12 months:** You've hit your expansion number, your book grows net revenue year over year, and at least one play you built is used across the team.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend
* 100% employee coverage for Health, Dental, Vision
* Commute stipend to help get you to and from work
* Free lunch and dinners
* Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii, Jackson Hole)

Compensation Range: $150K - $250K

**LiveX AI · Recruiter / People Operations**  
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, in-person · Department: People · Reports to: CEO  
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/recruiter-people-operations (posted Oct 6, 2026)

### **About LiveX AI**

LiveX AI builds human-AI interfaces for physical spaces. Its 4K full-body AI agents greet, guide, and sell in retail flagships, hotels, hospitals, airports, convention centers, and stadiums, on-prem or in the cloud, in 140 languages.

LiveX is growing across engineering, solutions, go-to-market, and operations, and hiring has outgrown what the founders can handle. This is the company's first dedicated People hire: no HR team, no existing processes. Own full-cycle recruiting for all open roles and the employee experience from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, plus clean exits. Roughly 70% recruiting / 30% onboarding and offboarding. Reports to the CEO, works with every hiring manager; a path to Head of People as the team grows.

### **Responsibilities**

**Recruiting (primary)**

* Run full-cycle recruiting for engineering (AI/ML, full-stack, hardware/edge), solution engineering, sales/GTM, and operations: intake, job posts, sourcing, screening, scheduling, debriefs, offers, closing.
* Proactively build pipeline via sourcing tools, referrals, university/new-grad programs, AI and robotics communities, and events such as NVIDIA GTC; do not wait for inbound.
* Run a fast, candidate-friendly process: structured interviews, scorecards, same-week feedback, weekly pipeline report for the founders.
* Set up and maintain the ATS and key hiring metrics: time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer-accept rate, cost per hire.
* Manage agency and contract recruiters when used: negotiate terms, enforce quality, control spend.
* Work with founders on offers: leveling, base pay, commission and equity framing, closing candidates with competing offers.

**Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Own signed offer through day 90: offer letters, background checks, I-9 and E-Verify, new-hire paperwork, equipment/account setup with engineering, first-week schedules, 30/60/90-day check-ins.
* Keep the onboarding guide current; every new hire correctly set up in payroll, benefits, and the cap table on day one.
* Coordinate visa-related onboarding (H-1B, OPT/STEM OPT, TN) with outside immigration counsel: document collection, timelines, employee communication.
* Run offboarding: exit checklists, equipment/access recovery, final pay timing under California rules, exit interviews, documentation.
* Maintain accurate, compliant personnel files; point of contact for paperwork, benefits enrollment, and policy questions.

### **Requirements**

* 3–6 years of full-cycle recruiting, including in-house at an early-stage startup (seed to Series B, under ~50 employees).
* Experience hiring both software engineers and salespeople.
* Hands-on onboarding and offboarding end to end, including I-9 and new-hire compliance for California employees.
* Strong sourcing skills; comfortable cold-reaching senior ML engineers or enterprise AEs.
* Organized and systems-minded: builds processes, keeps ATS and personnel records clean without prompting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; often the first impression of LiveX for candidates.
* Discretion with compensation, equity, immigration, and personnel matters.
* Early-stage operator mindset; comfortable with no existing HR function.
* Able to work on-site in Palo Alto.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Recruiting for AI/ML, robotics, computer vision, or hardware roles.
* Hands-on with a modern ATS, HRIS/payroll platform, and cap-table software.
* Experience working with immigration counsel on employment visa cases.

### **Compensation**

Base salary $110,000 – $150,000 per year, plus equity and benefits; placement depends on experience and skills.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Send a resume and a short note describing the hardest role you have closed to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Recruiter / People Operations".

new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As the **Onboarding Operations Specialist**, you will be the operational heartbeat of Crusoe’s new hire experience. Sitting at the intersection of logistics, systems administration, and physical employee welcome experiences, you will ensure that every new hire receives a seamless, flawless, and memorable introduction to Crusoe from the moment they accept their offer through their first week.

This is a high-touch, detail-oriented, onsite role based in our San Francisco headquarters. You will manage complex onboarding logistics across our global footprint, administer core data workflows in our HRIS (Rippling, Workday) and ticketing platforms (Jira), and help bring our San Francisco in-person orientation experience to life every week.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **HRIS Data & Lifecycle Management:** Own the Jira onboarding queue for new hire offer acceptances. Launch and review new hire profiles in HRIS, ensuring precise data entry for segment allocation, EEOC tracking, IT department mappings, and state payroll registrations.
* **Data Changes & Cross-Functional Coordination:** Manage data change tickets (start date shifts, manager/department updates) in Jira and HRIS. Proactively notify cross-functional partners in IT, Workplace, Travel, and Payroll when changes impact logistics.
* **New Hire & Manager Communications:** Own the global onboarding inbox, delivering prompt, accurate answers to new hires. Maintain automated pre-hire HRIS workflows, email templates, and Slack communications to keep new hires and managers informed and prepared.
* **New Hire Travel Coordination:** Oversee new hire travel procedures and ensure effective internal and external communications related to travel needs.
* **I-9 & Compliance Operations:** Execute complete I-9 verification checks for new cohorts, manage E-Verify processing (including image checks), and follow up on outstanding documentation to maintain 100% legal compliance.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Operational Rigor & Attention to Detail:** Meticulous execution skills with a track record of handling high-volume operational tasks, logistics, and data entry without dropping details.
* **HRIS & Ticketing Systems Experience:** Direct hands-on experience using modern HRIS platforms (e.g., Rippling, Workday) and task management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Ability to communicate clearly and coordinate effectively across IT, Workplace, Travel, Payroll, and hiring managers.
* **Problem-Solving & Agility:** Strong troubleshooting instincts when start dates shift, virtual stream links mismatch, or last-minute schedule changes arise.
* **High-Touch Hospitality Mindset:** A passion for creating warm, memorable, and welcoming candidate and employee experiences.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience supporting multi-site or hybrid in-person and remote onboarding programs.

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $50.00 - $60.00 per hour. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

new_jobs.title: Office Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

We are a small team working on non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, starting with a headset that helps turn thought into text. It's early, hard research, and we're working on it together in San Francisco.

That work happens in our San Francisco office: research, engineering, and the data collection sessions that train our models. We're hiring our first Office Manager to run it, full-time and in person.

**Why this role matters to us**
-------------------------------

We're a team that takes pride in operational excellence. When the office runs well, researchers stay focused, participants have a great experience, and new teammates are productive on day one. When it doesn't, everything slows down.

This role is what keeps it running well. We treat it as core to the company, and you'll work directly with the founding team.

At its heart, this role is about care. You'll get to know the people here, notice what they need, and look after the space as if it were your own. If making a place feel welcoming and well run is something you take pride in, we'd love to meet you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Run the office**

* Keep food, snacks, and supplies stocked, and set up a simple way for people to request things.
* Manage cleaning, vendors, inventory, and device tracking.
* Own upkeep of the space: furniture, internet, utilities, keys and building access, air and temperature.
* Greet guests, candidates, and research participants, and set up a guest-access system for the office.

### **Take care of the team**

* Make each teammate's day-to-day setup smooth, from a new hire's first morning to small preferences.
* Notice what's broken or unsystematized and fix it.

### **Run company operations**

* Run payroll and similar important administrative work.
* Coordinate the hiring process: schedule interviews, host candidates on site, and keep them updated.
* Plan team events and offsites.
* Help make our data collection sessions a delightful experience for the participants who come in.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Proactive. You notice things before they become problems, and you'd rather fix something than report it.
* Warm and caring. People are glad when you walk in, and you treat everyone the same, from visitors to the CEO.
* Proud of your work. You care about the details, including the parts of the job that feel small.
* Organized. You keep many small threads moving without dropping any of them.

**Compensation and logistics**
------------------------------

* Location: San Francisco, fully in office, Monday to Friday
* Schedule: Full-time; we're open to part-time for an exceptional candidate
* Base salary: $110,000–$150,000, depending on experience
* Equity: Yes
* Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance

**Application process**
-----------------------

Our process:

* A 20-minute call to get to know each other.
* A conversation with the team in our office.
* A paid one- or two-day work trial, where you'll do real tasks alongside us.
* Reference checks
* Offer

new_jobs.description:
### **About Aegis Ventures**

**Aegis Ventures** is a next-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.

### **About the Company**

**Optain** is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.

Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.

In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide. Optain also acquired EyePACS, a teleophthalmology platform with a 15-year history and an established network of licensed optometrists and ophthalmologists who read retinal images for diabetic retinopathy screening.

### **About the Job**

As the **Clinical Operations Manager**, you will own the operations of Optain's provider network - the optometrists and ophthalmologists who read retinal images for health systems, clinics, and community health centers across the United States. The network has run for 15 years on the judgment and relationships of a small number of people. Your job is to turn that into documented policy, a measurable quality program, a capacity model that runs ahead of demand, and a governance rhythm in alignment with Optain’s Medical Director. You will report to the VP of Operations and work day to day with Optain's Medical Director. This is a non-clinical role for someone who has managed a network of contracted clinicians before, writes policy that physicians sign, and knows the difference between running a process and building one that doesn't need you.

Optain is at an inflection point. We have FDA clearance, a growing camera footprint, and a commercial pipeline that is moving fast. Behind every screening exam is a licensed grader reading the images through our EyePACS platform, and the operational infrastructure around that network is being built in real time. This role sits at the center of that work.

This is a remote, US-based position.

### **What You'll Do**

Own the grading playbook, SOPs, onboarding materials, and the provider network policy library

* - author, version, and maintain them, and route clinical content to the Medical Director for review and sign-off.
Establish documentation governance for the network - ownership, versioning, review cadence, and sign-off* - so operating knowledge lives in documents rather than in individuals.
Design and run the grader quality program, including sampling, over-read and discordance review, turnaround accountability, and performance feedback* - establish error rates and trends where today review is periodic and manual.
* Prepare quality reviews and escalations for Medical Director adjudication and carry out the resulting actions, including performance conversations and offboarding.
* Build and maintain a capacity model by state, customer, and license coverage, and set recruitment triggers ahead of turnaround breaches.
* Run the grader recruitment pipeline from sourcing through interview and recommendation, working with the Operations Manager on credentialing and onboarding execution.
Own intake, triage, and routing of customer and grader complaints, including urgent findings workflows* - route clinical questions to the Medical Director, close the loop with the customer, and trend issues over time.
* Set the agenda, prepare decisions, and follow through so the Medical Director's time goes to clinical judgment rather than logistics.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on platform improvements that reduce manual work, including documenting current-state workflows so feature development is accurate and fast, and contribute network measurables to the weekly grader operations rhythm and company scorecard.

### **What You'll Need**

5+ years in healthcare operations, with 2+ years managing a network of contracted or affiliated clinicians

* - telehealth, teleradiology, or virtual care strongly preferred over traditional medical group or IPA settings.
* Has written clinical or operational policy that a physician leader signed, and maintained it afterward.
* Has run or materially contributed to a clinical quality, peer review, or provider performance program.
* Prior experience operating a clinician network under a medical director's clinical oversight is a strong plus.
* Exposur

**About Us:**Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

**About the Role:**

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

**Position Details:**

**Reports to:** President

**Direct reports:** Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

**Location:** Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

**Travel:** Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

**Schedule:** Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development

* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.

* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

### **Operations and Compliance**

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Trial Manager – Clinical Operations
new_jobs.description:
For over 25 years, dicentra has been a trusted global leader in regulatory consulting and clinical research for the life sciences and dietary supplement industries. We partner with innovators worldwide to navigate complex regulatory landscapes, turn scientific rigor into commercial success, and bring safe, compliant products to market.

We have an immediate opening for an experienced Clinical Trial Manager to oversee active clinical trial programs, trial site operations, and monitoring activities. We are open to full-time or part-time fixed-term employment, as well as independent consulting arrangements, depending on the candidate’s experience and availability.

**The Opportunity**

In this role, you will take operational ownership of Phase I–IV clinical studies. You will oversee clinical site management, coordinate site monitoring, troubleshoot clinic-level challenges, ensure ICH-GCP compliance, and work cross-functionally with data management and trial vendors to hit study milestones on schedule.

You will also serve as a key point of contact for sponsors, investigators, and external partners, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution of study-related challenges.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Trial Planning & Execution: Plan, initiate, and manage clinical studies in compliance with ICH-GCP, study protocols, and company SOPs, ensuring study timelines, budgets, and deliverables are met.
* Monitoring & Site Management: Coordinate clinical site monitoring activities, verify data integrity, and support clinical trial sites directly.
* Clinic Problem Resolution: Act as primary escalation contact for trial sites and clinical staff, proactively troubleshooting deviations, patient recruitment hurdles, and operational bottlenecks.
* Vendor & Data Coordination: Collaborate with Data Management and trial vendors on CRF review, EDC user acceptance testing (UAT), query resolution, and database lock.
* Ethics & Regulatory Submissions Support: Support site-level IRB/REB submissions, essential document collection, and inspection-readiness maintenance.
* Clinical Documentation Oversight: Review and provide operational input on study protocols, informed consent forms, and other essential clinical trial documentation.

**Qualifications & Background**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Nursing, or related field.
* Experience: 5+ years of clinical research experience, with at least 3+ years in clinical trial management or senior CRA/site monitoring roles within a CRO or sponsor environment.
* Regulatory Acumen: Deep working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and Health Canada / FDA clinical trial operational requirements.
* Execution Focus: Strong project management abilities, organizational skills, and a track record of driving trials to database lock.
* Sponsor & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to independently manage sponsor relationships, coordinate cross-functional teams, and resolve complex clinical trial challenges.

**Why join us**

**Best Workplace**
  
*We nourish an environment devoted to honesty and fairness, trust and respect. We care deeply for our team members and take work-life balance seriously, allowing our people to decide on a schedule that best fits their life and working preferences.*

**Best People**
  
*We unite cross-industry professionals with a shared passion for improving people’s health and wellness. Our inspiring leaders are accessible and work eagerly side-by-side with individual employees to help them understand and achieve their objectives.*

**Best Opportunities**
  
*We encourage our team members to continuously develop and enhance their skills and expertise. We recognize and reward courageous choices and innovative ideas that result in the growth of our people and company, and the success of our clients.*

**Become a part of a purpose-driven and future-oriented business that impacts and improves millions of lives worldwide!**

**Job Type:** Full-Time Employment, Part-Time Employment, or Independent Consulting Contract (Project-Based / Ad-Hoc)

**Location:** Ontario (Fully Remote)

**How to Apply**

This position is available to fill immediately.

We welcome applications from qualified professionals interested in full-time or part-time fixed-term employment, as well as independent consulting arrangements. Please indicate your preferred engagement arrangement and availability when applying.

Applying:

As part of the hiring process, in addition to interviewing, successful candidates may be required to complete a skills assessment and a reference/background check. If you are sent a skills assessment, please complete it for consideration for the advertised position.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
new_jobs.description:
Big Blue Marble Academy (BBMA) is an early childhood development and education leader with more than 90 schools across 9 states. Our programs include early care, childcare, preschool, and after-school care designed around what a child needs for their age and stage of development. Our curriculum is focused on global education and teaching children the importance of giving back and helping others in need. We the structure and encouragement children need to foster their curiosity and love of learning. Our teachers provide children with hands-on activities preparing them for success in school.

**Quality Assurance Manager Job Description**

The Quality Assurance Manager (QA) plays a critical role in risk prevention, safety and compliance, all of which help ensure operational excellence across BBMA’s portfolio of schools. Working in connection with school management and higher levels of BBMA Operations, this position plays a critical role in “left-of-loss” risk prevention, and ensuring ongoing compliance with safety, and regulatory initiatives while driving consistency, quality, and continuous improvement to ensure each school meets and exceeds BBMA’s standards.

The QA Manager works collaboratively across departments to ensure schools feel fully supported as they enhance overall operational quality, fostering a culture of accountability, partnership, and continuous growth.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute quality assurance audits across all locations identifying compliance gaps

* Predict and prevent risks before they materialize

* Establish and track KPIs and report trends and build early-warning systems and predictive models related to quality, compliance and service delivery

* Partner proactively with all levels of BBMA Operations to ensure assigned schools operate in compliance with federal, state, and local laws, and childcare licensing regulations - evaluate performance against standards

* Develop, train, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures and best practices - develop risk-awareness culture and scenario-based readiness

* Monitor adherence to company policies, safety standards, and licensing requirements

* Identify opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and overall school performance

* Analyze operational and other data to drive improvements in quality

* Support all levels of BBMA Operations through coaching and ongoing development

* Create and manage training content within the Learning Management System (LMS)

* Conduct regular site visits (60-75% travel) to evaluate school performance

* Identify recurring issues and partner with leadership to implement sustainable solutions

* Develop and manage auditing tools, reporting systems, and tracking processes

* Review parent and staff feedback to improve service quality and experience

* Prepare detailed reports on audit findings, trends, and improvement plans

* Communicate insights and recommendations to senior leadership and other key stakeholders

* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure alignment and successful implementation of initiatives

* Lead special projects related to quality, compliance, and operational improvements

* Maintain confidentiality of all company information and data

**Educational and Experience Requirements**

* A Bachelor’s degree with a preference for an additional certification in Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Risk Management Professional (RMP), Certified Materials & Resource Professional (CMRP), Certified Safety and Health Manager (CSHM), OSHA Safety and Health Fundamentals, Certified Risk Manager (CRM) and similar certifications

* Background in building early-warning or predictive analytics systems

* Minimum of five (5) years of risk management and quality assurance experience which may be with combined operations experience, preferably in multi-site environments

* Preferred knowledge of childcare licensing regulations and compliance standards

* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data analysis)

* Experience with quality assurance systems, databases, and reporting tools

* Proven ability to manage multi-site projects and drive results

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to details

* Takes initiative and completes tasks autonomously while maintaining quality standards

* Able to travel regularly to support business needs

  

A career with Big Blue Marble Academy will empower you to reach your career goals while making a difference in the lives of the children we serve.

  

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of our background check, pre-hire screenings, and onboarding processes. All employment is at-will and may be terminated at any time, with or without cause.

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Serving the largest customer ecosystem in regulated energy, HData helps utilities, regulators, advocates, advisory firms, and energy technology companies turn regulatory complexity into strategic advantage. By reducing the time and cost burdens of manual research and analysis, the HData platform enables teams to efficiently monitor regulatory developments, prepare for proceedings, mitigate potential risks, and confidently make decisions that consider comprehensive data.

We are a venture-backed Techstars company with investment from firms including Buoyant Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, Firebrand Ventures, and MassMutual Ventures. We work closely with our customers to understand their pains, and we collaborate across all teams to build and deliver exceptional products.

### **THE OPPORTUNITY**

HData is building the first extension of an Enterprise Customer Success team dedicated to Data Request Management (DRM), an AI-native platform solution that helps utilities manage and respond to the hundreds of regulatory data requests they receive during rate cases and other proceedings. As a Senior Enterprise CSM, you’ll own large, multi-team DRM deployments at some of the country’s largest utilities, guiding them from rollout to measurable value, and you’ll help define how HData delivers DRM success at scale.

We are hiring up to two team members for this role, with level (Enterprise CSM or Senior Enterprise CSM) based on experience.

This is a remote role open to candidates in any U.S. time zone, with up to 20% travel for onsite deployments, executive reviews and industry events.

### **WHO YOU ARE**

You’ll thrive here if:

* You’re energized by building something new: playbooks, processes, and the first version of how things are done.
* You’re at ease in a room with a VP of Regulatory Affairs and equally comfortable configuring a workflow with their analysts.
* You lead with curiosity and learn complex domains quickly.
* You measure success by customer outcomes, and revenue follows from that value.

### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Lead Enterprise Deployments**

* Own onboarding and rollout of DRM across large utility customers, leading discovery, mapping use cases to workflows, and partnering with Solutions Architecture on configuration.
* Guide customers through change management across legal, regulatory and operations teams, from executive sponsor to end user, with a focus on early, measurable value.
* Deliver training and workshops that establish HData as a core part of each customer’s regulatory process.

**Build Strategic Relationships**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for your book of customers.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business objectives and build a mutually agreed success plan that defines, tracks and measures HData’s impact.
* Lead executive business reviews and steering committees with your most strategic customers.

**Drive Adoption and Customer Health**

* Monitor usage, adoption and health data to identify risk early, close training gaps and surface new opportunities.
* Escalate critical issues to the right internal teams, keep customers informed through resolution, and advocate for their needs with Product.
* Develop reference customers, power users and advocates.
* Report weekly on success KPIs to internal stakeholders.

**Own Renewals and Expansion**

* Lead renewals and grow accounts by identifying new use cases, teams and departments where HData can deliver value.
* Partner with Account Executives on account strategy, proofs of concept and expansion opportunities.

**Bring Industry Insight**

* Stay current on utility regulatory trends and use that knowledge to share best practices and benchmarks with customers.
* Connect customers with peers to build a collaborative DRM community.

### **WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree or MS degree.
* 3+ Years of Experience in enterprise CS or account management (6+ years for Sr. ECSM), with a track record of managing a multimillion-dollar book.
* Enterprise SaaS experience, ideally with workflow, response management, compliance, legal technology, or security platforms.
* Proven ability to build strong relationships with both technical stakeholders and executives, with ability to identify, forecast, and negotiate complex contract expansions and renewals with C-level and procurement stakeholders.
* Deep experience managing the full customer lifecycle and growing a portfolio of complex Enterprise accounts, from onboarding and enablement to renewal, risk and escalations, expansion, and advocacy.
* Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.

### **BONUS POINTS**

* Experience supporting customers in regulated or compliance-heavy environments (energy, financial services, security, legal, or government), and the curiosity to learn utility regulatory processes quickly.

### **WHAT WE VALUE**

* Be kind
* Think and act with humility
* Be resourceful
* Listen to others
* Show empathy
* Have fun and enjoy others

### **WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Compensation:** $135-155k OTE (base + variable); commensurate with experience
* **Equity:** We offer equity to every employee at HData.
* **Location:** We’re a remote-based company. As long as you’re in the US, you can work from anywhere!
* **PTO:** Flexible; we care about output, not hours.
* **Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, 401k (with a match)

*HData believes the best teams are built with people of different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We hire for talent, drive and values alignment, without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

new_jobs.description:
The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early phase site network, fully dedicated to oncology clinical research. Throughout our history, START has provided hope to cancer patients in global community practices by offering **"Hope Through Access”** to cutting edge trials throughout the United States and Europe.

We are hiring for a **Regulatory Operations Specialist (Remote)** who will prepare and submit documents for new and existing studies to the Institutional Review Board (IRB), US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) for review, maintain the Investigator Site File (ISF) for assigned investigational drug studies and corresponding documents at START USA sites.

This is a remote role. The hourly pay for this remote role is $25 - $28/hour. However, base pay may vary depending on multiple individualized factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Prepare and submit new studies, including drafting the informed consent (IC), to the IRB as assigned under supervision. Serve as primary point of contact with the Sponsor/CRO in negotiating the IC for IRB submission. Serve as the main point of contact with the IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up on pending items.
* Prepare and submit study documents to the IRB for assigned studies under supervision. This includes, but is not limited to, revised protocols, revised investigator’s brochures, protocol clarification letters/memos, revised ICs, new ICs, continuing review reports, closure reports, serious adverse events, IND safety reports, unanticipated problems, protocol deviations, waivers, etc. Serve as the main point of contact with the IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up on pending items.
* Prepare and submit study documents to the Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) as assigned under supervision. Serve as the main point of contact with the IBC for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s), note pending information and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up, as required, on pending items.
* Prepare and submit Expanded Access Studies to the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as assigned under supervision. Serve as the main point of contact with the FDA and IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up, as required, on pending items.
* Maintain ISF (paper and/or electronic) for assigned studies. This includes, but not limited to, IRB submissions, IRB approvals, and correspondence.

  

**Required Education and Experience:**

* High School Diploma/GED.
* 5 years of experience in a regulatory research setting.
* Proficient working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook 365.
* Prior experience with regulatory document management system (i.e. Veeva, Advarra E-Reg).
* Strong organizational skills and a sense of timeliness in completing projects.
* Strong knowledge of medical and clinical research terminology.

  

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree.

  

**Best-in-Class Benefits and Perks**

We value our employees’ time and efforts. Our commitment to your success is enhanced by a competitive compensation, depending on experience, and an extensive benefits package including:

* Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance provided
* Robust retirement planning: 401(k) plan available with employer matching
* Financial security: Life and disability insurance for added protection
* Flexible financial options: Health savings and flexible spending accounts offered
* Well-being and work-life balance: Paid time off, flexible schedule, and remote work choices provided
* Plus, we work to maintain the best environment for our employees, where people can learn and grow with the company. We strive to provide a collaborative, creative environment where everyone feels encouraged to contribute to our processes, decisions, planning, and culture.

  

**More About START**

  

START clinical trial sites have conducted more than 1,000 early-phase clinical trials, including dozens of therapies that were approved by the FDA or EMA. START represents the world’s largest roster of early-phase principal investigators across its Network of clinical trial sites. Committed to accelerating passage from trials to treatments, START delivers hope to patients, families, and physicians around the world via our mission of “Hope Through Access”.

Learn more at STARTresearch.com.

Brown & Brown does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters, recruitment vendors or employment agencies ("Recruiting Vendors"). Recruiting Vendors must have a valid written agreement and received prior written authorization from an authorized Brown & Brown representative before submitting candidates for any publicly posted role. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown & Brown or its employees become the property of Brown & Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. Additional information regarding this policy can be found on our careers page.
